- HARDENING: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, `_POLLER_CURL_SHIM` (lines 627-648). The capture shim redacts Authorization headers but would log credentials passed as `-u <user:pass>` / `--user <user:pass>` (curl basic-auth form) verbatim into `curl_calls.log`. Suggested minimal fix: extend the redact loop with `-u|--user` next-arg redaction plus a `--user=*` / `-u*` glued-value case, mirroring the existing `-H` handling (about 4 lines changed).
